title: Read p⁵ boxes
statement:
How many unpaired electrons does a p⁵ ground-state subshell have?

[_]{a}

explanations: Two boxes are paired and the third is singly occupied.
Five orbitals are not available in p.

hints: Put one in each before pairing.
The last two electrons form pairs in two boxes.
solution: There are three orbitals. Put one in each before pairing. The last two electrons form pairs in two boxes. Two boxes are paired and the third is singly occupied.
